name: fresh-change-measurements
goal: Collect source measurements from the selected commit across all entity pages, retain fresh workload observations, and require change measurements in Harness guidance.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Old prepared history contains 1244 units with no source observations and a record with no measurements. Local pages must enrich from the exact selected Git commit without rewriting stored evidence. Current source observations must outrank missing record placeholders. Changed executable units require real representative timing and memory observations with revision, workload, target and profile; no invented or borrowed values.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: History indexing tests proved fresh builds but never read an older prepared revision through the local server. Formatter tests covered absent values without a current source observation and did not test its precedence. Extend these existing standard tests and the existing multi-metric browser scenario across entity kinds and viewports; preserve originals and commit attribution.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
